headline: Alan Cumming shares his Nightcrawler experience
post:
Get ready for the multiverse to collide as heroes from different franchises come together in Avengers: Doomsday! Behind the scenes, Alan Cumming returned as Nightcrawler and shared that the make-up process was reduced to an hour-and-a-half, largely because his tattoos were no longer applied individually by hand.

He also described working on the film as "healing" compared to his experience on X2. Are you excited to see these universes collide on the big screen?
